From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Subject: Weekly numbers 'bake' + commit playbook — 30m sprint

Team —

Quick note to lock in a short, tactical session today to triage late-stage accounts and update commit signals. This is a 30-minute "numbers bake" focused on:
- Top 6 late-stage deals (verify close plan / blockers)
- Any required price/SLA approvals to move to commit
- Stage corrections and explicit confidence % updates in CRM

Agenda (30m):
1) 0-5m: Quick lane read (Vivek)
2) 5-20m: Rapid triage on top 6 (owner calls in order) — owners bring 1-line ask
3) 20-28m: Commit decision + any escalation needed
4) 28-30m: Action owners & docs to update (who updates forecast row)

Prep: I attached a current pipeline snapshot and an export of the deals I think we should cover. Please:
- Update stage/confidence in the snapshot before the call if you can (column: "Confidence")
- Add single-line blockers under the Notes column

Join link: Meet — "Forecast Bake" (same room as today's cadence).

If you can't make, drop your top-2 asks by 10:00 and I will call them.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Attachments: pipeline_snapshot_Q3.xlsx (spreadsheet), acme-demo-notes.pdf (PDF)
